Lower Text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When another of your Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name is played, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By deleting 1 of your Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name, this Digimon may digivolve into [Diaboromon] in the hand without paying the cost.
